name: WE BUILD eInvoice Attestation
description: JSON Schema for the SD-JWT VC claims set of the eInvoice attestation (vct: eu.we-build:einvoice:1)

display.name: eInvoice
display.description: An invoice from a seller to a buyer, carried in the wallet and presentable without contacting the seller.

display.label: Buyer electronic address
display.description: EN 16931 BT-49. Address/endpoint identifier for delivery/receipt handling. Section 2.3.

display.label: Currency
display.description: EN 16931 BT-5. ISO 4217 invoice currency code. Section 2.2.

display.label: Amount due
display.description: EN 16931 BT-115. Total payable amount. Section 2.2.

display.label: Attestation category
display.description: Legal category of the attestation. For this rulebook profile the exact value SHALL be `non-qualified-EAA`. Section 2.1.

display.label: Buyer country
display.description: EN 16931 BT-40 (seller)/BT-55 (buyer). ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

display.label: Buyer identifier
display.description: Legal-entity identifiers; at least euid SHALL be present.

display.label: Buyer
display.description: EN 16931 BT-27 (seller)/BT-44 (buyer). Registered legal name.

display.label: Buyer VAT number
display.description: EN 16931 BT-31 (seller)/BT-48 (buyer). VAT/tax registration identifier.

display.label: Buyer
display.description: The Buyer (relying party). Optional as a whole; if present, all members SHALL be present. v0.8: replaces the flat buyer* claims.

display.label: Cryptographically bound to
display.description: vct of the Supplier's EBWOID attestation on the same Wallet Unit to which this attestation is bound. RECOMMENDED. Section 2.6 / Chapter 4.

display.label: Evidence references
display.description: References to supporting evidence items (e.g. purchase order, delivery note). Section 2.3/2.4.

display.label: Invoice format
display.description: Identifier of the invoice representation/profile used for the payload. Code list, Section 2.8.

display.label: Status
display.description: Business lifecycle status for corrections, cancellations and credit notes. If omitted, the lifecycle status SHALL be interpreted as `active`. Distinct from the registered `status` metadata claim used for Token Status List revocation. Sections 2.3, 2.8 and IR-EI-09.

display.label: Invoice number
display.description: EN 16931 BT-1. Invoice identifier, unique for the Supplier within the duplicate-detection window (IR-EI-04). Section 2.2.

display.label: Payload hash
display.description: Hash of the canonicalized invoice payload; binds the attestation to the external EN 16931 / Peppol BIS invoice (IR-EI-03). Section 2.2. NOTE: canonicalization method and hash algorithm are OPEN pending WP4 confirmation; sha256 assumed here.

display.label: VAT total
display.description: EN 16931 BT-110. Total VAT amount for this invoice; SHALL equal the sum of taxSubtotal.taxAmount when taxSubtotal is present (IR-EI-07). Section 2.2.

display.label: Issued
display.description: EN 16931 BT-2. Invoice issue date (RFC 3339 full-date). Section 2.2.

display.label: Payment instructions
display.description: EN 16931 BG-16. Payment-related information. Contains sensitive payment data; issuer MUST make selectively disclosable. Section 2.3/2.4/3.2.

display.label: Preceding invoice
display.description: EN 16931 BT-25. Identifier of the original or preceding invoice. SHALL be present when invoiceLifecycleStatus is corrected, cancelled or credited; MAY be omitted when the lifecycle status is active or omitted. Section 2.4 and IR-EI-09.

display.label: Seller country
display.description: EN 16931 BT-40 (seller)/BT-55 (buyer). ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

display.label: Seller identifier
display.description: Legal-entity identifiers; at least euid SHALL be present.

display.label: Seller
display.description: EN 16931 BT-27 (seller)/BT-44 (buyer). Registered legal name.

display.label: Seller VAT number
display.description: EN 16931 BT-31 (seller)/BT-48 (buyer). VAT/tax registration identifier.

display.label: Seller
display.description: The Supplier (issuer). Mandatory. v0.8: replaces the flat seller* claims.

display.label: Tax subtotal
display.description: EN 16931 BG-23. VAT breakdown, one entry per tax category/rate. Section 2.3/2.4.
